criteria.requirement: Add visible_content=False and a per-handle hidden_regions count integrated before actual tag/data side effects. In opt-in mode omit entire template or HTML hidden-attribute subtrees (attribute presence including hidden="false"), including nested formatting/resources; handle void hidden elements without hiding following siblings and recover matching ancestor closes without corrupting existing quiet/head/style/script accounting. Unclosed hidden EOF hides the remainder of only that document and state resets before reuse. Default text remains unchanged, do not infer CSS/script visibility or claim sanitization; counts report top-level omitted regions.
